result.title: Coarse Semantic Blocks for Efficient Training-Free Sparse Attention
result.summary: We introduce a training-free sparse attention method that builds a prompt-specific key index to accelerate both prefill and decoding. The method clusters the keys into large semantic blocks that group tokens from noncontiguous positions. Each query position selects blocks by scoring their centroids and attends to the original keys and values within them. Queries that select the same block are processed together, so prefill stays fast even though each query chooses its own blocks. Large blocks make centroid scoring and this grouped processing cheap, so each query can attend to more tokens in the same time. Larger blocks with a larger token budget can thus be both faster and more accurate on long-context tasks than smaller blocks with a smaller budget. We evaluate two hybrid LLMs, Qwen3.5-4B and 35B-A3B, on one NVIDIA H200. Including the cost of building and using the index, whole-model wall-clock speedups over dense attention are 2.3-2.4x for prefill and 1.7-2.0x for decoding at 512K tokens, and 2.9-3.0x for prefill at 1M. The 35B-A3B model stays close to dense attention on five RULER tasks through 1M, on LongBench-v2 overall, and on MRCR through 256K. The 4B model loses accuracy mainly on multi-key retrieval, yet outperforms dense Qwen3.5-2B, whose latency is similar at 512K, on all three benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的稀疏注意力方法：把 key 聚类成跨位置的粗粒度语义块，查询按块质心打分选块后只在块内注意原始 key/value，并合并选择同一块的查询，从而同时加速 prefill 与解码；在 Qwen3.5 长上下文模型上报告速度与精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其块级 key 索引与质心打分可供核查视觉 token/证据筛选及 KV 选择是否影响 latent 状态的细节保留，但论文仅面向纯文本长上下文效率、无多模态推理验证，联系较间接。
